Sam: Hey team — addressed the review comments on PR #842. Squashed the tiny follow-ups into one commit. Could someone give final eyes? @Priya @Diego
Priya: Taking a look now :eyes:
Sam: Quick summary of changes: fixed null-check in allocator, added a unit test for kv-cache rotation, tightened a log message, and clarified an error name.
Sam: CI passed locally but one integration test flakes on our CI matrix. I added a temporary skip with a TODO to follow up in a separate issue.
Sam: Local run command if you want to repro: ```pytest tests/integration/test_allocator.py::test_rotation -q```
MergeBot: CI status updated — all checks passed on latest push (build/ci: success).
Diego: Quick skim — tiny nit: prefer `allocErr` vs `err` in the allocator loop for clarity. Otherwise LGTM.
Sam: Good call, renamed and force-pushed (rebased the small fix).
Taylor: If CI is green I'm happy to approve. How big is the diff?
Sam: Small — ~6 commits before squashing, mostly fixups. I plan to squash into one change; prefer keeping history tidy.
Priya: I can give the second approval in ~30m. Do we need to reserve a canary window?
Sam: Yes please — target is tomorrow morning for a brief canary. I added a calendar entry: https://calendar/redwood/canary/tomorrow-am
Diego: Approved. :thumbsup:
Priya: Approving now. :heavy_check_mark:
Sam: Thanks all — will merge after canary slot is confirmed. Quick note for ops: merge command I’ll use: ```git fetch origin && git checkout fix/kv-alloc && git rebase -i origin/main && git push origin fix/kv-alloc --force && gh pr merge 842 --squash```
Taylor: Sounds good. Ping if the canary shows any regressions and we can rollback.
Sam: Will do. Appreciate the quick eyes.
